content: Portugal: DL 122/2000 (amended Lei 92/2019) transposes Database Directive 96/9/EC incl. sui generis right against substantial extraction/re-utilisation; DL 47/2023 adds TDM exceptions with machine-readable opt-out; Lei 109/2009 cybercrime law on unauthorised access. No scraping-specific case law found. Low-volume personal price lookups of non-substantial parts are low risk; circumventing anti-bot measures is the riskier act.
